text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It should be about time.
They said it'd be on the evening news...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Since I promoted Tomakomai to the absolute fullest during that nationwide street interview, there's bound to be a huge response...!)

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
"...And those were the voices from the streets.
Next up, the latest news."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh, wait... it's not... coming out...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No way! Why!?
Why won't you use it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having her street interview cut out from the broadcast,
Hokko Tarumae was thoroughly disheartened.
